name: Bordernet
summary: Rural satellite/dial-up/ADSL ISP; began as Ozsky.net (1997) + Murray River Internet Solutions (2001); absorbed Nella Networks clients (2004); acquired by Bigblu Broadband (SkyMesh parent) 2017 (BORDERNET INTERNET PTY LTD, ACN 103 155 693).

events.details: Ozsky.net founded Deniliquin NSW; became Bordernet Dec 2001. 1997 founding predates the archive (earliest ozsky.net capture 28 Nov 1999, branded 'OZSKY'); BORDERNET INTERNET PTY LTD, ACN 103 155 693, registered 1 Jan 2003.
